text: Adriana's puppy arrives Saturday morning. She's going with a cocker spaniel and has already named him Biscuit.
Zofia had her gallbladder out on Tuesday. She's home now but sore, and says she can't laugh without wincing. I should drop round some soup on Thursday afternoon.
Tamar is pregnant! Due March 9th. She's only told family so far.
Omar's cat Pepper has a lump on her side. Vet appointment is Monday at 10:15 and he's really worried about it.
Remind me to text Mei on the 14th at lunchtime to see how her scan went.
Dafydd and his wife are having the baby christened on June 8th at 11am, St Mary's. We're invited to the lunch afterwards.
Arjun's dad is in for a knee replacement on November 3rd. Arjun is taking a week off work to look after him.
Booked the car in for its MOT, Wednesday at 8:30.
Rafael mentioned his daughter Ines starts nursery in January. He's dreading the drop-off more than she is.
Carlos and Marisol's little boy was born this morning! 7lb 2oz, called Mateo. Need to send flowers before Friday.
Rohan's hernia surgery has been cancelled again because of staff shortages. He's fed up. Don't forget to ring him at the weekend.
Dimitri said his rabbit, Clover, turns five on 4/22. Apparently there will be a cake made of carrots.
Gustavo is recovering well after the heart stent. Back at work from May 2nd, part time to begin with.
Niamh is 30 weeks now and the heartburn is awful. She can't sleep more than a couple of hours at a time.
Bridget's mum had a fall last night and is in A&E. Bridget is with her. I must call her tomorrow morning before work.
Aleksander - Alek to everyone - has adopted two retired greyhounds. Says they sleep 20 hours a day.
Wiremu is having his wisdom teeth out Friday at 2pm. He's nervous; he fainted last time at the dentist.
Nia's baby shower is on the 18th at 3pm at her sister Olga's flat. Olga is organising and says nappy vouchers would go down well.
Lovely chat with Anders. He's taken up birdwatching since the hip operation and wants a decent pair of binoculars.
Kieran's dog Mabel was put to sleep yesterday. She was fourteen. He's heartbroken.
Call the surgery about my repeat prescription before Thursday.
Joy is having the first scan at the end of the month. She and Chidi are both excited but trying not to get ahead of themselves.
Anan has a follow-up with the consultant on September 12 at 4:40. I'm driving him there.
Marta told me her nephew was born early, at 33 weeks, and is in the special care unit. Her sister is exhausted. I should ask Marta how they're getting on next week.
Sadia's kitten has finally been spayed. All went fine and she's already back to climbing the curtains.
Chen said Wei is having her tonsils out on the 25th. She's 32 and the recovery is meant to be grim for adults. Ice lollies would be a good thing to bring.
Aidan's cockatiel turned ten last week. He had a little party for it, with family on video call.
Need to message Adriana after Biscuit's first vet jabs on Wednesday afternoon.
Zofia's daughter Marisol is expecting twins in August! Zofia is going to be a granny for the first time and can hardly contain herself.
Saw Tamar's husband Omar at the pharmacy. Tamar's had terrible morning sickness and has been signed off work for two weeks.
Mei is having a cataract operation on 7/30 at 9 in the morning. Her son is taking her and bringing her home.
Don't forget Dafydd's grandson's christening is the Sunday after next. Buy a card and a silver spoon or similar.
Arjun has started physio for his shoulder, Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6pm. He hates it but it's working.
Rafael's cat went missing on Saturday night. He's put up posters and is checking the local Facebook group every hour. Must share the post.

Carlos is back from hospital after the appendix. Turns out it had burst, so he was in for five days instead of one. Marisol has been doing everything at home with the baby as well, and she sounds completely wiped out. I'll take them a lasagne on Sunday evening, and I should offer to walk the dog for them this week.
Rohan and his partner Ines found out they're having a girl. Gender reveal was a bit of a flop because the cake was blue inside by mistake.

Dimitri's mum is having a hysterectomy on October 30th. He's flying out to Athens on the 28th to be with her and coming back November 6th, unless she needs him longer. His sister Olga can't get time off, so it's all on him, and he admitted he's finding it hard. Must text him on the 30th in the evening to see how the operation went.

Took Gustavo for coffee. He's convinced the new puppy is cleverer than his kids. She's a border collie called Luna, eleven weeks old, and has already chewed through two phone chargers and a skirting board. His wife wasn't keen on getting a dog at all but now Luna sleeps on her side of the bed. Puppy training classes start on Saturday at 9.
Niamh's baby arrived! Little girl, born Sunday at 4am. No name yet. Need to send a card and congratulations.
Ask Bridget on Monday how her colonoscopy went.

Mrs Evans next door is home after her hip replacement. Her son is staying with her until the end of the month, then she'll be on her own again. She's worried about the stairs and about her cat, Smudge, who keeps trying to sit on her lap. I said I'd feed Smudge in the mornings. Need to ask her son for a spare key before he leaves on the 31st.
Aleksander said the christening for baby Zara is now May 21st at noon instead of the 14th, because the vicar double-booked.

Wiremu's wife Joy had a mammogram recall. Results appointment is next Thursday at 11. Wiremu is trying to stay positive but they're both anxious, and Joy hasn't been sleeping. Their kids don't know yet. He asked if I could have the youngest after school that day, which I'm doing. Joy loves those almond pastries from the bakery on Hill Street.
Nia is on bed rest for the last six weeks of the pregnancy. She's bored out of her mind and has started knitting tiny hats. Could bring her some audiobooks or a jigsaw.
Anders' husband is having a vasectomy on Friday at 3:30. Anders thinks it's hilarious; his husband does not.

Kieran is getting another dog in the spring, a rescue lurcher. He wants to wait until the grief has settled a bit. He's been volunteering at the shelter on Sunday mornings since Mabel died and says it helps. His partner Aidan is more of a cat person but has come round. They're hoping for one that's good with their niece, who visits every other weekend.
Long chat with Dr Murphy's receptionist. My knee MRI is on 11/19 at 7:45am. Bring the referral letter and don't wear anything metal.

Joy's baby is due June 3rd, but her midwife thinks it'll be early. Joy really wants a water birth if the hospital can do it. Chidi has painted the nursery yellow and assembled the cot twice because he did it backwards the first time. Her mum arrives May 20th. Joy said the thing she actually wants is a good breast pump, since everyone keeps buying tiny outfits.

Anan's dad had a stroke last week. He's stable but still in hospital and can't speak properly yet. Anan is going in every evening after work. I need to check in with him on Friday and maybe offer to cover his shift on Saturday.
Marta's hamster escaped and spent two days living inside the sofa. Found safe this morning.
Sadia is going in for IVF egg collection on the 9th at half 8. She's been injecting for two weeks and feels awful. Text her the night before to wish her luck.
Chidi said Joy's parents are flying in from Lagos on August 1st to help with the baby. They're staying for three months.
Olga's operation went well. She was out of theatre by 2pm on Tuesday and the surgeon was happy. Send her something to say I'm glad.

Chen and Wei's dog had nine puppies overnight! They're keeping one and the rest are already spoken for. Chen jokingly offered me one. Their spaniel Honey was in labour from about 10pm until 6 this morning, and Wei stayed up with her the whole time. The vet is coming round on Thursday at 4 to check them all. I should go and see them once they've settled.
Need to pick up the dog food and flea treatment, and book Mango's jabs for early next month.
Aidan says his sister Adriana had her second baby on May 14 at 10pm. A boy, Leo. Aidan is now uncle of two and very smug about it.
Tamar asked me to be godmother at the christening in the autumn. I said yes, obviously.
Remind me to ring Omar's mum, Mrs Hughes, after her cardiology appointment Monday at 2. Omar can't go with her because he's away.
Carlos phoned from the hospital; Marisol's in labour. Nothing to do except wait.

Long walk with Rohan. He's still struggling after the surgery on 6/5, sleeping badly and in a lot of pain. His GP has upped his painkillers. He doesn't want visitors yet, but I should message him on Friday morning and again the following week, and maybe drop off some groceries so he doesn't have to go out.
